rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for delaying or staying until someone or something arrives.

example.english: Wait for me a moment first.

rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to refer to the period spent waiting.

example.jyutping: dang2 ge3 si4 gaan3 zan1 hai6 hou2 coeng4

rows.note: Use this when the wait is a delay to a service, journey, event, or schedule rather than simply time spent waiting.

example.english: The flight delay made us wait for an hour.
example.traditional: 班機延誤，搞到我哋等咗一個鐘。
example.jyutping: baan1 gei1 jin4 ng6 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 dang2 zo2 jat1 go3 zung1

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone works as a waiter or serves customers at tables.

example.english: They wait tables at a restaurant during the summer holiday to earn money.
example.traditional: 佢暑假去餐廳企檯搵錢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 syu2 gaa3 heoi3 caan1 teng1 kei5 toi2 wan2 cin2
